headers.//: The invitation makes no external requests at all: the bundle, the styles and the fonts are inlined, the machine's stills and clip are same-origin, and the clip is prefetched into a blob. So everything can be locked to 'self' and the page still works. 'unsafe-inline' is needed for scripts and styles because vite-plugin-singlefile inlines them, and a hash would have to be regenerated on every build.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
accelerometer=(), camera=(), display-capture=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
